name: Model Router
description: Routes OpenClaw subagent spawns to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed sessions_spawn call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the spawn's one-line label, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow, each with its own key. The spawn of the requesting agent itself sends that agent's description when it has one and a fixed text when it has none. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings. The scope setting picks the spawns: core routes the spawn of the requesting agent itself; extended also routes the spawns of other agents that set no model. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process OpenClaw starts.

provider.label: Scoring provider
provider.help: Whose model scores each subagent task: typesafe, openai or google.

gateway.label: OpenRouter gateway
gateway.help: How the provider is reached: direct (its own API only), auto (its own API, then OpenRouter), openrouter-first (OpenRouter, then its own API) or openrouter (OpenRouter only).

scope.label: Routing scope
scope.help: Which subagents are routed: core (the default agents only) or extended (also other agents, as the README lists).

models.label: Scoring models
models.help: The scoring model per provider as provider:model entries for typesafe, openai or google, such as {typesafe:jev-latest, openai:gpt-6-luna}; a provider with no entry uses its default.

small_model.label: Small model
small_model.help: The model a task rated small gets, as provider/model; unset, the task keeps the model it would get without the plugin, and the plugin still sets its effort.

middle_model.label: Middle model
middle_model.help: The model a task rated middle gets, as provider/model; unset, the task keeps the model it would get without the plugin, and the plugin still sets its effort.

large_model.label: Large model
large_model.help: The model a task rated large gets, as provider/model; unset, the task keeps the model it would get without the plugin, and the plugin still sets its effort.

api_key.label: TypeSafe API key
api_key.help: The plugin sends it to TypeSafe when provider is typesafe and gateway is not openrouter.

openai_api_key.label: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.help: The plugin sends it to OpenAI when provider is openai and gateway is not openrouter.

google_api_key.label: Google API key
google_api_key.help: The plugin sends it to Google when provider is google and gateway is not openrouter.

openrouter_api_key.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.help: The plugin sends it to OpenRouter when gateway is not direct.
